optimization_velocity.stage_rationale: 5 iterations, 7 entries, all in untested/new maturity bucket. ~18 tasks seen of 100. No entry has graduated to developing or battle-tested. Key shift in iter 5: the bottleneck is increasingly non-compliance with existing rules rather than missing coverage. f9a44264 content validated but agent doesn't follow it reliably. Failures remain a mix of easy mistakes (not applying synonym expansion, not decomposing queries) and hard ones (task 126 may be at capability limits). Metric trend 0.33→0.28→0.61→0.50→0.39 shows high batch variance with no clear direction. The playbook needs both more task exposure and better compliance, not just more content.
optimization_velocity.recent_mutation_success_rate: 2/7 entries have any positive signal (7ca56b8b +2, f9a44264 +1). 5/7 entries have 0 engagement/0 positive signal. Iter-5 additions (009bd398, a674b64e) untested.
optimization_velocity.recommendation: The emerging insight is that content correctness is ahead of agent compliance. Future mutations should consider: (1) testing whether consolidating search-monitoring entries improves compliance, (2) adding more concrete examples to entries (validated effective on f9a44264), (3) exploring structural changes (entry ordering, placement) rather than only content changes. Continue broadening task sampling to discover non-entity-ID gaps.
